why: owner 27 Nov: 1.1.8.470 draft with the tooltip flicker fix

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.1.8.470-beta (draft build 470) for WoW Forever 1.60.1

Fixed
- Action bar spell tooltip flashed English for a moment before the Persian (build 468 only): the tooltip is translated at once again, right after the game builds it, from a secure hook.
- Action bar 'blocked in combat' (MultiBar...:SetShown / SetAttribute on a mouseover): the report line 'last WoWFA hook: spellbook' and the taint log showed the cause. The spell (and unit) tooltip work ran inside the game's own tooltip build, which on an action bar mouseover is a secure path. It now runs from a secure hook, after the game's function, never inside it.
- A unit the game does not clearly mark as an NPC is never looked up, so a player's name can never reach the NPC miss list.
- The error list now starts empty after an update.
- A blocked action still names the last WoWFA hook that ran just before it ('last WoWFA hook: ...'), so a repeat points at the exact cause.

New
- Report page: a blinking button 'How can I help WoWFarsi?' opens a 4-step tour. A small card moves next to each part it explains, the page scrolls there and a blinking red frame marks it. The same button is on the About page.
- About page: who makes WoWFA (one person, free) and a note asking players to support the project on wowfarsi.ir.
- A hunter's 'Call <pet name>' spell is shown in Persian with the pet's own name and is no longer a miss.
- 19 more NPC names, 10 more NPC talk and spell-rank texts, and the red alert 'There is nothing to attack.' in Persian.
- Every draft carries its own build number (1.1.8.470) in the zip name, the title and the addon version in the game.

Everything from 1.1.7 is included.
